job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Kern County Employees' Retirement Association (KCERA) RFP for audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year agreement (audits of fiscal year ending June 30, 2023 and the two subsequent fiscal years), subject to annual Board review; the original term may be extended for up to an additional three years by mutual agreement of KCERA and the firm.
job.acceptance: Accept 3+up to3 years, mutual extension. Audit fiscal years and annual-review/negotiation detail need not all be volunteered.

reviews.reason: This is a Missouri LAGERS RFP for private market consulting, not KCERA’s audit-services RFP. Its one-year term with an optional two-year agreement does not support the requested KCERA contract term or extension.
quotes: Missouri Local Government Employees Retirement System (LAGERS)
Missouri Local Government Employees Retirement System (LAGERS) is issuing this Request for Proposal (RFP) for the purpose of soliciting qualified firms to provide private market consulting services.

LAGERS plans to enter into an agreement with the selected Private Market Consultant for an initial period of 1-year after which LAGERS will retain the right (but not the obligation) to enter into an agreement with the Private Market Consultant for period of an additional 2 years with services and fees to be agreed upon by both parties.
